texts.firmware.bios.about: The PocketStation's own program, 16 KB, dumped from a real unit. Its menu starts every app, so nothing runs without it.
texts.setting.hardware_id.about: The PocketStation's serial number, as eight hex digits. Every unit has its own, and some games read it: one game's companion app works out a rank from it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.card.help: The PocketStation's memory card: a whole card (.mcd, .mcr, .mc, .mem, or a .bin of 128 KB), a DexDrive dump (.gme), one save (.mcs) or one app (.pss). Pokket works out which from the file's contents. The PocketStation's own menu, in its BIOS, starts the apps on the card.
texts.slot.savedata.help: A memory card to start with in place of the one above. This is the file that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes. Put it back under the same name, card.mcd, to continue from where another run stopped. The file is never changed. Leave it empty to start with the card above.
